title: TREMOLO (Digitone insert audio)
author: irpina
description: TREMOLO, the smallest insert-audio mod for the Digitone mk1: TREMOLO in core-dn1's Mod Menu (hold a track key) turns a 4 Hz tremolo on everything the Digitone plays on, and picking it again turns it off; every key, knob and screen stays the Digitone's. A template for an effect on the Digitone's output: it names no firmware address, so its OS 1.44 port is empty (docs/ADAPTING.md, "Insert audio"). Needs core-dn1 3.3.
